summary: A no-trade day, and the reasoning holds up after the close. The Proposer made no proposals, so there was nothing to approve. Cash was $70.61 (11.4%), only about $9 above the 10% buffer, the Market Analyst was risk-off at 0.42 confidence, and the payrolls print was a rates unknown. Standing aside was defensible on that information. Since the version 5 start on 11-03 the agent is -0.12% against the shadow's -1.37% and SPY's -2.53%, so the cash and defensive tilt helped. Over the full period the agent trails the shadow (+2.72% vs +3.29%) because it is 88.6% invested against 99.3%. That gap is the price of the buffer and should not be treated as an error. The stop review checked out against the close. BTC/USD closed near $75.8k (value/qty), about 0.7% above the roughly $75.3k stop, so the stop is intact but the margin is thin. IDXX closed near $676, about 7% above its $630 stop, a little better than the ~$660 I estimated. CARG fell 6.7% on the day, so the soft Q4 sales guide did hit the price, which I flagged as unknown. It still sits about 16% above the $28.25 stop and is +7.5% on cost, so the thesis is intact. My CARG thesis text says +14.7% on cost, which is now stale. SPY and the staples names (DPZ -2.3%, KR -2.5%, WMT -1.9%) fell together, so the staples stack was not the shelter I called it. Re-anchoring the VOO and VTI SPY-200-day line to 727.38 was a sound use of thesis_updates. No fills occurred and no sell condition fired.
lessons: BTC/USD closed about 0.7% above its stop. If the next close is below ~$75.3k, sell in full next session; do not re-anchor lower to avoid the trigger.

CARG gapped down 6.7% after a beat with a slightly soft guide, so an earnings print can be mixed on the numbers and still reprice the stock. When the price reaction is missing from inputs, say the position's cost at a 10% gap and avoid writing +X% on cost into the stored thesis, since the number goes stale overnight.
The Consumer Staples label (WMT, DPZ, KR) fell 2-2.5% together on a down day, so a staples stack did not hedge a market drop. Keep treating it as one concentrated bet and do not add to it.
Staying about 88.6% invested versus the shadow's 99.3% cost about 0.6 points of return overall but saved about 1.2 points since 11-03. Judge the cash buffer over a full drawdown, not by the up days.
Intraday mark estimates from value/qty were off by up to ~2.4% (IDXX about $660 vs $676 actual). Quote the stop distance with a range, or use the stored close when it is available.
